description: This file implements function wrapping functionality for functorch.dim, providing classes and functions to support dimension-aware operations and integrate them into PyTorch workflows.

classes.name: WrappedOperator
classes.description: A class that wraps PyTorch operations to support first-class dimension arguments, managing metadata and callback invocation for dimension-aware functionality.
